decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Supporting Planning Statement dated 15 March 2018, Transport Statement dated 15 March 2018. P01, Design & Access Statement rev1 May 2018, Transport Technical Note JNY8791-04a dated 04 June 2018. Received: 04/06/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for B1(a) Office and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 5 - Before the extension hereby permitted is first occupied, full details of the proposed cycle parking spaces, in a convenient, covered and secure location with stands that are not vertical or semi-vertical in nature shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities as approved shall then be provided at the site at all times.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the occupation of the development, at least two of the proposed car parking bays shown on drawing JNY8791-23A, Appendix A of the Transport Technical Note dated 04 June 2018 and prepared by RPS shall provide electric vehicle charging points capable of an output of at least 7.2kW and a further bay provided with a passive provision. The electric vehicle charging points/bays shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.
description: Erection of a rooftop extension to the existing units 1-4
